name: Qwen3.8-Max
summary: Call a 2.4-trillion-parameter multimodal model that scores near Claude Fable 5 on coding and long-horizon work. Live now through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and QwenCloud, with open weights promised within a week.

name: Inkling-Small
summary: Download an Apache 2.0 reasoning model that takes text, images, and audio with a 1M-token context, and lands within a point of its 975B sibling at a quarter the size. Weights on Hugging Face.

name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
summary: Run an open-weight (MIT) coding and agent model for pennies — about $0.14 per million input tokens, $0.28 output. This re-tuned build beats the bigger V4-Pro preview on agentic tasks. Grab the weights on Hugging Face or hit the API.

name: Seedance 2.5
summary: Generate a full 30-second video in one shot at up to 4K — no stitching clips together. Feed it up to 50 reference images, and fix a single frame without re-rolling the whole thing. Available via API and partner apps.

name: GPT-5.6 price cuts
summary: High-volume jobs on the fastest GPT-5.6 tier just got 80% cheaper — Luna is now $0.20 per million input tokens, $1.20 output. Mid-tier Terra dropped 20% to $2/$12, and premium Sol runs 2.5x faster in the API.

name: Claude Opus 5
summary: Get near-Fable-5 quality at half the price, now the default on Claude Pro and Max. A low/medium/high effort toggle lets you dial cost against capability per task, with sharper autonomous coding. Live in the API today.

name: FLUX 3
summary: Generate video with native synced audio, edit images, and render readable text from one multimodal model. Video is in early access at bfl.ai now, with image generation and downloadable open weights coming. Already powering Photoshop and Picsart features.

name: Claude Security
summary: Scan your repo for vulnerabilities without leaving the terminal. A set of agents maps the codebase, cross-checks findings, and hands back a report with suggested patches. Installs as a Claude Code plugin on any paid plan.
